chunks: Al-Kafi: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Arabize our narrations, for we are an eloquent people.

key_terms.أَعْرِبُوا: Make Arabic / articulate in proper Arabic
key_terms.فُصَحَاءُ: Eloquent people / speakers of pure Arabic

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about how to transmit the hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) instructs his followers to ensure that the narrations (hadith) transmitted from the Imams are articulated in clear, proper Arabic. He emphasizes that the Ahl al-Bayt are a people of eloquence, implying that their speech should be preserved and presented with linguistic precision and clarity.
